name: whistle-vconsole
description: whistle vconsole 插件 + MCP server + H5 页面调试探针（fork 自 Tencent vConsole），面向 AI agent 的移动端 H5 调试工具

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @bobjoy/vconsole build && pnpm --filter @bobjoy/vconsole-vite build && pnpm --filter @bobjoy/whistle.vconsole build
scripts.test:e2e: node packages/whistle-plugin/test/ws-codec.unit.mjs && node packages/whistle-plugin/test/screenshot-loader.unit.mjs && node packages/whistle-plugin/test/e2e.mjs && node packages/whistle-plugin/test/multi-session.e2e.mjs && node packages/whistle-plugin/test/http.e2e.mjs
